stemMd: An action potential reaches a chemical synaptic terminal. What directly promotes fusion of neurotransmitter-containing vesicles?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Entry of intact red blood cells

options.label: D
options.textMd: Entry of calcium ions through voltage-gated channels

explanationMd: Depolarisation opens voltage-gated calcium channels. The local calcium rise activates the vesicle-fusion machinery, releasing transmitter into the synaptic cleft.

distractorRationale.a: Blood cells do not enter the synaptic terminal.
distractorRationale.e: That would damage the terminal rather than normally trigger release.
distractorRationale.c: DNA replication is not the rapid release trigger.
distractorRationale.b: Vesicle release requires no new nucleus.
